body.prompt:
A family picnic at East Coast Park at sunset

Set in Singapore. Any people shown are Singaporean or other Asian (a natural mix of Chinese, Malay, Indian and Eurasian), each one clearly different from the others in age, build, face, hair and clothes; good-looking, well-groomed, natural expressions. Polished lifestyle photograph. No text, no words, no logos, no watermarks.

A poster at a bus shelter. Headline: "Still dark."

Where the scene has a setting it is Singapore, shown through ordinary cues: HDB blocks, void decks, kopitiam tables, covered walkways, greenery, local shopfronts with no real names. No famous landmarks or skyline icons: no Marina Bay Sands, ArtScience Museum, Merlion, Gardens by the Bay, Singapore Flyer or CBD skyline. No real place names, transit, mall, bank or shop logos, or vehicle liveries. People only where the scene calls for them: one or two adults at most, Singaporean or other Asian, in an everyday moment that fits who buys from the brand (at a desk, in a car, at a kopitiam table), never a posed group around a phone.

make the sky bluer

Change only what is asked and keep everything else in the picture exactly as it is. Anyone added is Singaporean or other Asian.
